title: Naked100 Salt Nic E-Liquid – Apple Cooler 30ml
description:
Description
Apple by Naked 100 E-Liquid is a terrific combination blending together accented notes of crisp smooth apples, sweet table grapes, and succulent summertime watermelons to create an exhilarating fruity flavor laced with a cooling uplifting menthol that packs a punch reserved solely for the taste buds.
Naked100 Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Naked100 Salt E-Liquid is intended for small form factor, fillable pod systems. Ensure your customers are properly informed as Naked100 Salt E-Liquid contains significantly higher levels of nicotine per milliliter.
50% VG 50% PG
